Subject-object contact alternatives remain available only when matching third-person typed participants create a real ambiguity.

The emphatic particle ca belongs to a following comment and is blocked outside topic-before-comment order.
Choosing or recapturing a principal is separate from linear order, so nested topics and genuine principal ambiguity remain structurally explicit.
An information question requires an owner-issued interrogative NNC supplement and automatically derives sentence-initial order and question punctuation; it does not add a movement control.
The interrogative supplement keeps the replaced supplement's typed subject, object, or possessor link, while genuine principal or head ambiguity remains a user choice.
